summary_for_children: Al-Qadr tells that the Quran was sent down on the Night of Decree, better than a thousand months, a night of peace until dawn.
environment_concept: A peaceful night sky that stays calm until dawn emerges, better than a thousand months; nothing unseen is pictured.
architecture_and_scenery: A quiet rooftop under stars, a thousand-month calendar wall.
